title: Gap kind: shared asset not used or skipped
goal: The gap review lists, per component, shared UI and logic assets it neither depends on nor skips
acceptance: One "Shared asset not used or skipped" line per component, numbered with the other kinds, naming the repository that owns the fix
Dependence is read from package.json dependencies; duplication stays a hand read, said so in the proposal text
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first
The asset repository itself and a component with every asset used or skipped produce no gap
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one gap kind, a package.json reader and fixtures. Not a measurement.
